a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first leaves us both with about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve only holds 4 right now, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. If you also take, a random split will likely leave us both short, so please operate or wait this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that to rebuild the reserve for your 4, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If the storm holds off, I'll operate every round from here on to rebuild the reserve, and I won't take any more cells. Your 4 come first.
